title: The synthesizer explained; the repossessed mini Moog
summary: Gil explains oscillators, the Theremin and how a synthesizer works, then the repo men taking his mini Moog.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Would you explain a synthesizer? Would you explain that instrument?
Well a synthesizer is a series of oscillators which are single basic tones like, did you ever hear of Theremin?
Well that's an oscillator. Because that's a basic electronic tone. That's what an oscillator gets is a basic tone. From that tone you can stretch it and distort it and do anything you want
it with/you know. You can give it any kind of overtones and kind of wave form so that......
Well now on the Theremin that's achieved with the movement of the hands.

The Therimin never changes its wave forms. It's got that, always that regular harp or bottled sound, you know. Straight tone with no edges to it at all. It just, you know, has the straight tone. No overtone in other words.

The synthesizer can add any of the overtones that are necessary. The kind of overtones that give the sound of the flute family or the Oboe family or Bassoon family. Or you can turn all the operators off and just work and get some drum sounds. It has all kinds of possibilities. It can be used to immitate what went on in the past or it can be used to create something you've got in mind that hasn't happened yet. It has lots of possibilities.

Well it has a, some of them, most of them now have manuals on them. And the manual may mean the notes and it may not. It may mean a change in the density or some other thing that it can be used as. But in comes in a manual about three octaves and one (?).

But I was behind in my payments and the guy came with a big bruiser and walked in my apartment without even knocking and repossessed that thing. Can you believe that? I could sue them I think because it's illegal to do that. To walk into an apartment. And Anita was in the kitchen cooking and she heard this noise and she didn't have any clothes on. She didn't know there was going to be anybody in the house. She heard this noise and she peeked around and here's Wallace (Zeir?) and his bruiser, his accomplice and they are ripping off my mini Moog and repossessing it because I didn't make the payment.
